names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 17 decembrie, «Sfântul Proroc Daniel și Sfinții trei tineri Anania, Azaria și Misail», with the rank words left off; the life spells it «Daniil».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 17 Δεκεμβρίου, «Προφήτης Δανιήλ και οι Άγιοι Τρεις Παίδες Ανανίας, Αζαρίας και Μισαήλ», with the rank word left off. The page glosses the name itself, «(εβραϊκή λέξη) = η θεία δίκη».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s first heading for 17. децембар ст. ст., „Свети пророк Данил и три отрока: Ананије, Азарије и Мисаил.“ — with «Свети» left off, which §5 says is not a rank, and «пророк» left off, that being the `prophet` grade §5 maps and `types` keeps. The bare forename is the whole of what the heading gives him. THE FOLD WAS MEASURED BEFORE THE FORM WAS WRITTEN AND IT IS A REAL ONE: `fk.mjs` puts the key `данил` at ONE other holder, `daniel-of-thasos`, so this form takes the fold from one member to two and a new READ_FOLDS key goes into `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in this same commit. It is NOT the «Данил (Донале)» of this same day’s second entry: that string keys as `данил донале` and folds with nothing.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (28 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 17 decembrie — «Sfântul Proroc Daniel și Sfinții trei tineri Anania, Azaria și Misail»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 17ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Προφήτης Δανιήλ και οι Άγιοι Τρεις Παίδες Ανανίας, Αζαρίας και Μισαήλ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the corpus already keeps for them, and the entry is the same four: Daniel renamed Belteshazzar and the three Hebrew youths who would not worship Nebuchadnezzar's golden image. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. saint.gr adds that Daniel is one of the four major prophets, that he was of the tribe of Judah and of royal descent, that he was born at Upper Bethara, that he was taken captive to Babylon as an infant with his parents, that he and the three were schooled at the imperial court by Nebuchadnezzar's provision and given great place in the state when they came of age, and that he died in deep old age most probably at Susa. **It dates him to the end of the seventh and the beginning of the sixth century before Christ**, which is recorded in `dates` only where the folder had none. It names Upper Bethara, Babylon and Susa; no coordinate is proposed, because the page itself says «πιθανότατα» of Susa. It prints an apolytikion naming all four, which is taken into each of the four folders; a kontakion naming Daniel alone, which is taken into his; a second kontakion addressed to the three in the furnace, which is taken into theirs; and an oikos and a kathisma, which are kinds the schema does not hold.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 30.12.2025 (17. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети пророк Данил и три отрока: Ананије, Азарије и Мисаил.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. **It is a heading that names its three companions, so it is four folders and not one** — BRIEF.md §4’s ruling — and the corpus already held all four from the Romanian and Greek calendars, which print the same four names in the same order. The third calendar to keep him. `types` UNTOUCHED: «пророк» is the `prophet` held. **A SECOND GRADE WAS DECLINED AND IS AN AUTHOR QUESTION**: this book has Daniel himself beheaded with the sword for the true faith, on the authority of Saint Cyril of Alexandria, which would make him a `martyr` as the three youths already are; it is one clause of one book against two calendars that rank him prophet only, and the predecessor’s refusal of a grade written on one word of one book is followed here. `dates` ADDED, the folder having carried NONE: a floruit of about 500 BC. **THE THREE YOUTHS GET NO DATES FROM THIS READING**, and the reason is grammatical — the sentence that carries the figure, «Живео и пророковао на пола хиљаде година пре Христа», is singular and stands after the sentence that reckons Daniel among the four great prophets, so it is his. NO `locations`: Jerusalem, Babylon and Mount Gebal are three places and the folder has never held a coordinate. NO `related` ROW ADDED: the three youths and `cyril-of-alexandria` were all four here already; Nebuchadnezzar, the Jewish king Joakim, Belshazzar, Susanna and the two elders are no folders this corpus holds, and the four great prophets this book lists beside him — Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel and Daniel — are a list of the book’s own and not his companions, which is why that list is HERE and not in the life: `isaiah-the-prophet`, `jeremiah-the-prophet` and `ezekiel-the-prophet` all carry those three words as their whole display name, and writing them unlinked in prose would demand three reverse `related` rows that nothing in this entry justifies. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS: that all four were OF THE ROYAL TRIBE OF JUDAH; that Daniel was carried off as a boy with the Jewish king Joakim and a multitude of other Israelites when Nebuchadnezzar destroyed and plundered Jerusalem; that his fame among the Jews of Babylon began with the two lustful and unjust elders and the saving of the chaste Susanna, and his fame among the Babylonians on the day he guessed and interpreted the king’s dream, for which he was made a prince at court; the three words on the wall at Belshazzar’s feast, «мани, текел, фарес», which nobody but Daniel could read, and the king’s killing THAT NIGHT; that he was thrown into the lions’ pit TWICE and saved both times; that he saw God on his throne with the angelic powers; and the order of the beheadings and the angel who carried the four bodies to Mount Gebal. ITS LAST TRADITION IS RECORDED AND NOT RANKED: that these four rose at the time of the death of the Lord Christ, appeared to many, and then slept again. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Mari sunt faptele credinţei; că în mijlocul izvorului văpăii, ca într-o apă de odihnă sfinţii trei Tineri s-au bucurat şi Prorocul Daniel păstor leilor ca unor oi s-a arătat. Pentru rugăciunile lor, Hristoase Dumnezeule, miluieşte-ne pe noi.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Proroc Daniel și al Sfinților trei tineri Anania, Azaria și Misail (one hymn printed for the four together)

english.text: Great are the achievements of faith: in the midst of the fountain of flame, as in restful water, the three holy Youths rejoiced, and the prophet Daniel was shown to be a shepherd of lions as of sheep. By their prayers, O Christ God, have mercy on us.

hymns.text: Μεγάλα τὰ τῆς πίστεως κατορθώματα! ἐν τῇ πηγῇ τῆς φλογός, ὡς ἐπὶ ὕδατος ἀναπαύσεως, οἱ ἅγιοι τρεῖς παῖδες ἠγάλλοντο· καὶ ὁ Προφήτης Δανιήλ, λεόντωv ποιμήv, ὡς προβάτων ἐδείκνυτο. Ταῖς αὐτῶν ἰκεσίαις, Χριστὲ ὁ Θεός, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος β’, printed without a model. It names the Three Youths and Daniel together, so it is the service of all four and is taken into each of the four folders, on the page of «Προφήτης Δανιήλ και οι Άγιοι Τρεις Παίδες Ανανίας, Αζαρίας και Μισαήλ».

english.text: Great are the achievements of faith! In the spring of the flame, as at the water of rest, the holy Three Youths rejoiced; and the prophet Daniel was shown to be a shepherd of lions, as though of sheep. At their entreaties, O Christ God, have mercy on us.

hymns.text: Καθαρθεῖσα Πνεύματι, ἡ καθαρά σου καρδία, προφητείας γέγονε, φαεινοτάτης δοχεῖον· βλέπεις γὰρ ὡς ἐνεστῶτα τὰ μακρὰν ὄντα, λέοντας, ἀποφιμοῖς δὲ βληθείς ἐν λάκκῳ· διὰ τοῦτό σε τιμῶμεν, Προφῆτα Μάκαρ, Δανιὴλ Ἔνδοξε.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον. It names Daniel alone, so it is taken into his folder only, on the page of «Προφήτης Δανιήλ και οι Άγιοι Τρεις Παίδες Ανανίας, Αζαρίας και Μισαήλ».

english.text: Cleansed by the Spirit, your pure heart became the vessel of the brightest prophecy; for you see as present the things that are far off, and cast into the pit you muzzle lions. For this we honour you, O blessed prophet, glorious Daniel.

floruit.note: The first date this folder has carried. Охридски пролог за 17. децембар ст. ст.: „Живео и пророковао на пола хиљаде година пре Христа.“ — he lived and prophesied about half a thousand years before Christ. **The bounds are that round figure and nothing was invented around it**: the book’s «на пола хиљаде година» is an approximation and the display carries it as «c.», but no century bracket was put on either side of 500, because the book gives none and a bracket would be this reader’s and not its. doxologia.ro and saint.gr both gave this folder no year at all. The captivity under Nebuchadnezzar and the reign of Belshazzar are both in the entry and neither was turned into a bound, a king’s reign not being a year. The basis is traditional, no document being cited.
